name: git-workflow
description: Git branching, pull request, and merge/deploy workflow conventions

interface.shortDescription: Git branching, pull request, and merge/deploy workflow conventions
interface.longDescription: Standard branching model, dual-PR (production + pre-prod) workflow, stacked-PR management for multi-subtask epics, a resolver that finds each repo's pre-prod branch, a pre-check that blocks pre-prod PRs that would conflict or show unrelated files from tickets the pre-prod branch already has, back-merging the default branch with a drift audit that keeps the pre-prod branch equal to the default branch plus unreleased work, a fresh-context review of the branch's own diff before its PRs are opened, and cleaning up local branches and worktrees once nothing in them is local-only.
defaultPrompt: Open the standard main + pre-prod PRs for this branch
Set up a stacked-epic trunk for this feature
